message.content: In the conversation regarding Red Dead Redemption 2, Jareth shared an experience that resonated with him. Specifically, Jareth mentioned spending time helping the townspeople, which added depth to Arthur's character. Jareth highlighted a particular side mission where Arthur helped a widow in the honor system. This side mission showcased Arthur's transformation and demonstrated his empathy, which connected Jareth more deeply to Arthur and the world of the game. This interaction was described as highlighting Arthur's growth from a rough outlaw to someone who genuinely cared about his loved ones.
